posts:
Dominant performance secures a near-certain semi-final spot in the T20 World Cup.

Ellyse Perry has starred with bat and ball as Australia gave their net run-rate a massive boost with a landslide win over Bangladesh at Headingley in the T20 World Cup.
Evidence: All-round performance, decisive victory, strong net run-rate #Cricket #T20WorldCup

Ellyse Perry was instrumental, taking 2-14 and scoring 19 not out, as Australia convincingly defeated Bangladesh by nine wickets. The win significantly boosted Australia's net run-rate and all but secured a semi-final berth.
Stated Judgement: (1.5, 1.5) — Greater Good

Australia restricted Bangladesh to a mere 8-77 from 20 overs, with their bowlers, including Perry, Molineux, Garth, and Sutherland, performing exceptionally. Australia then chased the target with 63 balls remaining, making 1-78.
Resulting Judgement: (1.5, 1.5) — Greater Good
